issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares addGuestStudents(int) with a void return type, but the solution implementation defines addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. This mismatch between the specified signature (UML) and the solution's method return type is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the expected contract and will cause test/signature mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution's addGuestStudents method to have a void return type and simply update the number of guest students (matching the UML), or (B) update the problem statement UML and any tests/templates to declare addGuestStudents(int): boolean and document the meaning of the boolean return (e.g., success/failure). Ensure the template, UML/spec, and tests all use the same signature.
